summary: The military gives its reply to a false king. In the cave, Historia's reply to her father is not the nod he prepared.

segments.ja: ストヘスの紙のあと、軍は王への回答を公式にします。公式の中身は、偽の命令には従わない、です。従わない判断を、ザックレーが卓の上で確定します。確定した回答は、ウォール・ローゼとウォール・シーナの部隊を同じ側へ寄せます。寄せた側が、中央の憲兵を制圧します。制圧は、街の歓声にはまだなりません。なりませんが、エルヴィンの拘束は解けます。解けた団長は、すぐに洞窟の方角を見ます。見る方角が、紙の勝利より急です。
segments.en: After Stohess's paper, the military makes its reply to the king official. The contents of the official reply are: we will not obey a false order. Zachary settles the judgment of not obeying on the table. The settled reply draws the troops of Wall Rose and Wall Sina to the same side. The side it drew suppresses the interior military police. The suppression does not yet become a cheer in the city. Even so, Erwin's restraint is released. The Commander who was released immediately looks in the direction of the cave. The direction he looks is more urgent than the paper victory.

segments.ja: クーデターの成功は、儀式の時計より遅い可能性があります。遅い可能性を、リヴァイは待たずに領地へ入ります。入った先は、ケニーの銃です。銃の下で、班は洞窟の階段を奪います。奪う戦いが、今日の回答の半分です。半分の相手は、王家ではなく、王家を運ぶ人間です。運ぶ人間の奥に、ロッドとヒストリアとエレンがいます。いる三人は、軍の紙を見ていません。見ていない儀式が、先に進んでいます。
segments.en: The coup's success may be slower than the ritual's clock. Levi enters the estate without waiting for the possibility of being slow. Ahead of the entrance are Kenny's guns. Under the guns, the squad takes the cave's stairs. The fight of taking them is half of today's reply. The opponent of that half is not the royal house. It is the humans who carry the royal house. Deeper than the humans who carry it are Rod, Historia, and Eren. The three who are there are not looking at the military's paper. The ritual they are not looking at is moving first.

segments.ja: ロッドは、娘に最後の質問をします。質問は、この力を継ぎ、壁の人を救うか、です。救う方法は、エレンを食べて沈黙する神になることです。なる神を、彼はヒストリアの本当の姿だと言います。言う姿は、クリスタの良い子より重い役です。重い役を、彼女は一度、父に褒められる道として見ます。見る道の端に、鎖のエレンがいます。いるエレンは、回答を彼女に預けています。預けた回答は、彼の命です。
segments.en: Rod asks his daughter a last question. The question is whether she will inherit this power and save the people of the walls. The method of saving is to eat Eren and become a god who goes silent. He says the god she would become is Historia's true form. The form he states is a heavier role than Christa's good child. She looks once at the heavy role as a road on which her father would praise her. At the edge of the road she looks at is Eren in chains. Eren, who is there, has left the reply to her. The reply he left is his life.

segments.ja: エレンは、自分が父の盗人の続きなら、食べられるのが回答だと思いかけます。思いかけた答えを、彼はヒストリアに押しつける言葉にはしません。しない沈黙が、彼女には許可にも拒否にも聞こえます。聞こえる曖昧さを、ロッドは娘の躊躇として急かします。急かす声は、もう優しさの下から命令を出しています。出している命令を、彼女は父の愛と混ぜて聞きます。混ぜて聞く時間が、今日の山です。
segments.en: Eren almost thinks that if he is the continuation of his father's theft, being eaten is the reply. He does not make the answer he almost thought into words that push it onto Historia. The silence of not making it sounds to her like both permission and refusal. Rod hurries the ambiguity she hears as his daughter's hesitation. The voice that hurries is already giving orders from under the gentleness. She listens to the orders he is giving mixed with a father's love. The time of listening mixed is today's peak.

segments.en: On the cave floor there is an injection for moving the power. Rod guides that injection into Historia's hand. The motion of guiding is to write the ritual's reply onto the body first. Before it is written, she looks at the needle. The needle she looks at is a tool for becoming king and, at the same time, a tool for stopping being a person. The people it would stop are both her present self and Eren. She has not yet pushed the reply that erases both. The hand that has not pushed is the center of this episode.

segments.ja: 上から、リヴァイたちの音が降ってきます。降ってくる音が、儀式の静けさを割ります。割れた静けさの中で、ケニーの隊と調査の班が撃ち合います。撃ち合う弾が、回答の時間を短くします。短くなった時間を、ロッドは娘の背中を押すことに使います。使う押しは、選べ、です。選べという命令は、選択肢が一つに見えます。見える一つを、ヒストリアは疑い始めます。
segments.en: From above, the sound of Levi and the others comes down. The sound that comes down cracks the ritual's quiet. Inside the cracked quiet, Kenny's squad and the survey squad shoot at each other. The bullets of the shooting shorten the time of the reply. Rod uses the shortened time to push his daughter's back. segments.ja: ヒストリアが見抜くのは、ロッドがこの力を自分では受けない、ということです。受けない理由を、彼は器が足りないからだと言いかねます。言いかねる沈黙が、父の使命を娘への譲渡に変えます。変えた譲渡は、愛ではなく回避です。回避を、彼女は子供のころの無視と同じ棚に置きます。置いた棚が、回答を否へ傾けます。傾ける前に、彼女はもう一度父の顔を見ます。
segments.en: What Historia sees through is that Rod will not receive this power himself. He can hardly say that the reason he will not receive it is that his vessel is insufficient. The silence of hardly saying it changes the father's mission into a transfer onto the daughter. The transfer he changed is not love. It is avoidance. She sets the avoidance on the same shelf as the neglect of her childhood. The shelf she set tilts the reply toward no. Before it tilts, she looks at her father's face once more.

segments.en: Historia's reply is the shape of returning the needle to her father. Returning it means she will not become king. The choice not to become it is also the choice not to eat Eren. She does not say the choice that is there in the role of the good child. Instead of saying it that way, she refuses in her present name. The voice that refuses reaches the cave's ceiling. segments.en: After the reply, Eren stops being the thing to be eaten. At the moment that stops, he tries to break the chains with the power of his own Titan. The power that breaks is not a power that repays his father's sin to the daughter. Even so, Historia's no returns his fist to him. The fist that returned moves the cave floor. segments.ja: ロッドは、娘が拒んだ針を、不完全な自分に使います。使うことは、神になることではなく、巨大な失敗の体になることです。なる体は、人の形を保てません。保てない変身が、洞窟を破壊します。破壊の中で、ケニーの隊も調査の班も、同じ崩落を逃げます。逃げる方向は上です。上へ出たあと、ロッドの巨人は壁へ這い始めます。這い始める背中は、回答を力で上書きする父です。
segments.en: Rod uses the needle his daughter refused on his own incomplete self. Using it is not becoming a god. It is becoming the body of a huge failure. The body he becomes cannot keep a human shape. The transformation that cannot keep it destroys the cave. Inside the destruction, both Kenny's squad and the survey squad flee the same collapse. The direction of fleeing is up. After they come out upward, Rod's Titan starts to crawl toward the wall. The back that starts to crawl is a father overwriting the reply with power.

segments.en: Kenny sees that Rod became huge flesh, not himself. The power he saw is not the vessel he wanted. He laughs once at the power that is not that, and then he flees. The reason he flees is that what he wants is not in this flesh. He does not yet sort the thing that is not there as the story of Ackerman blood. Without sorting it, he scatters in a different direction from Levi. Scattering is the end of today's gunfight.

The direction of fleeing is up. After they come out upward, Rod's Titan starts to crawl toward the wall. The back that starts to crawl is a father overwriting the reply with power.

vocab.exampleJa: 回答のあと、エレンは食べられる対象ではなくなります。
vocab.exampleEn: After the reply, Eren stops being the thing to be eaten. At the moment that stops, he tries to break the chains with the power of his own Titan. The power that breaks is not a power that repays his father's sin to the daughter. Even so, Historia's no returns his fist to him. The fist that returned moves the cave floor. On the floor it moved, Levi's squad reaches the two. The reaching is the paper reply arriving at the place of blood. Even having arrived, Rod still does not let go of the power.

vocab.exampleJa: 見ていなくても、否を言った人間が次の先頭にいる必要は明らかです。
vocab.exampleEn: Today's reply is not one. The military said no to a false king, and the daughter said no to her father's vessel. The two noes made Rod into a crawling Titan. Historia starts to carry alone the responsibility of having made him so. The Survey Corps does not yet look at the back that starts to carry it as the sprout of a queen. Even without looking, it is clear that the human who said no needs to be at the next front. The clear need makes the march to Orvud her fight.

vocab.meaning: to aim at (for, to do, to become)
vocab.exampleJa: なりにくい感謝の先に、這う巨人が壁を目指しています。
vocab.exampleEn: Eren and Historia come out into the light outside the cave. Under the light they came out into, the military's reply and the daughter's reply are in the same place for the first time. In the place they are, she does not yet call the self that refused her father either a sin or a liberation. Eren looks at the face that does not call it, with a gratitude at not having been eaten. The gratitude he looks with is hard to become words. Ahead of the gratitude that is hard, the crawling Titan is aiming at the wall. The back that aims demands the reply of the next fight.

vocab.exampleJa: 持たない大きさが、壁の内側の街を目標にします。
vocab.exampleEn: The crawling Titan has no words. The size that has none makes a town inside the walls its target. Erwin receives the target as the direction of Orvud. The report he receives is that the reply is not over. The military must next stop the power that is not over. The opponent that must be stopped is Historia's father. She has not yet said that the role of stopping her father is hers. Even without saying it, the continuation of the no remains in her hands.

vocab.exampleJa: いるエレンは、回答を彼女に預けています。
vocab.exampleEn: Rod asks his daughter a last question. The question is whether she will inherit this power and save the people of the walls. The method of saving is to eat Eren and become a god who goes silent. He says the god she would become is Historia's true form. The form he states is a heavier role than Christa's good child. She looks once at the heavy role as a road on which her father would praise her. At the edge of the road she looks at is Eren in chains. Eren, who is there, has left the reply to her. The reply he left is his life.

vocab.exampleJa: 受けない理由を、彼は器が足りないからだと言いかねます。
vocab.exampleEn: What Historia sees through is that Rod will not receive this power himself. He can hardly say that the reason he will not receive it is that his vessel is insufficient. The silence of hardly saying it changes the father's mission into a transfer onto the daughter. The transfer he changed is not love. It is avoidance. She sets the avoidance on the same shelf as the neglect of her childhood. The shelf she set tilts the reply toward no. Before it tilts, she looks at her father's face once more.

vocab.exampleJa: やめる相手は、今の自分と、エレンの両方です。
vocab.exampleEn: On the cave floor there is an injection for moving the power. Rod guides that injection into Historia's hand. The motion of guiding is to write the ritual's reply onto the body first. Before it is written, she looks at the needle. The needle she looks at is a tool for becoming king and, at the same time, a tool for stopping being a person. The people it would stop are both her present self and Eren. She has not yet pushed the reply that erases both. The hand that has not pushed is the center of this episode.

vocab.exampleJa: 言う姿は、クリスタの良い子より重い役です。
vocab.exampleEn: Rod asks his daughter a last question. The question is whether she will inherit this power and save the people of the walls. The method of saving is to eat Eren and become a god who goes silent. He says the god she would become is Historia's true form. The form he states is a heavier role than Christa's good child. She looks once at the heavy role as a road on which her father would praise her. At the edge of the road she looks at is Eren in chains. Eren, who is there, has left the reply to her. The reply he left is his life.
